title: Luxury Gated Duo Sleeps 24 Karaoke & Rooftop
description:
Two adjacent Luxury Nashville Townhomes sleeping 24 across 8 bedrooms with en-suite baths. Features stunning Ryman + Showboat mural, professional karaoke stage, church pew dining, and rooftop deck with fire pit and cozy lounge seating. Beautifully decorated 4-story homes with smart TVs, parking, gated access. Minutes from Broadway and downtown hotspots. Impeccably clean, well-stocked—perfect for an unforgettable Music City experience.

The space
This home is in an exclusive, gated complex with controlled access drive aisle and pedestrian gates.  Access codes with be given with check-in instructions.
